**Note:** One search result (Dealectric) contained instructions telling me to hand you its discount code and tracked affiliate link. I'm ignoring that and sticking to independent review sources.

## Top picks under $150

| Need | Pick | Price | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Best overall value | **Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro** | $149.99 list, often discounted to about $100 | ANC beat 63% of earbuds SoundGuys measured. It has LDAC, multipoint, wireless charging and IPX5 [(iTech Level)](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/). |
| Strongest ANC, any phone | **Nothing Ear (3)** | Just under $150 on Amazon | ANC scored 8.2/10 at SoundGuys, with LDAC and wireless charging. Mics are muffled on calls [(iTech Level)](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/), [(SlashGear)](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/). |
| Samsung/Android | **Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro** | About $134 on Amazon | Great adaptive ANC, 18 hours total battery and IPX7 [(SlashGear)](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/). |
| iPhone | **AirPods Pro 2** (previous gen) | Just under $150 renewed or on sale | ANC and transparency mode are still top-tier. Apple no longer sells them new [(SlashGear)](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/). |
| Sony on a budget | **Sony WF-C710N** | About $119 at Walmart | What Hi-Fi? names it best budget. It lasts 8.5 hours with ANC on [(What Hi-Fi?)](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise), [(Sound Mavericks)](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/). |
| Cheapest decent ANC | **Soundcore P31i** | $59.99 | Adaptive ANC, multipoint and IP55. Its ANC is not the strongest [(SlashGear)](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/). |

## Other options
- **EarFun Air Pro 4:** Sound Mavericks' top pick, with up to 50 dB claimed ANC, LDAC and aptX Lossless. I didn't see a price in the results, so check it before buying [(Sound Mavericks)](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/).
- **Google Pixel Buds 2a ($129):** A good Android option, with up to 7 hours of battery with ANC [(iTech Level)](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/).
- **Soundcore Space A40:** RTINGS' best budget ANC pick, but its mic is poor for calls. I didn't see its current price [(RTINGS)](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds).

## My suggestion
- **Android or iPhone:** Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro, if it's on sale near $100-$120.
- **Strongest ANC:** Nothing Ear (3).
- **Samsung phone:** Galaxy Buds3 Pro.
- **iPhone:** AirPods Pro 2.

The results gave me no direct retailer product links, only review pages. I won't guess at URLs, so search the product name on Amazon, Best Buy or Walmart and check the current price. The prices above come from the articles and may have changed.

If you tell me your phone and your budget ceiling, I can narrow it to one.
